name: Worldly Music
overview: Scripture teaches that music should be an expression of true worship, praising God sincerely in spirit and truth rather than conforming to worldly values. While the psalmist calls for praise in God's sanctuary, the wise recognize that not all music is beneficial, as foolish songs can mislead and distort good and evil. Believers are urged to prioritize the kingdom of God and His righteousness, discerning that what is esteemed by the world may be detestable to God, especially when it compromises spiritual integrity.
